title: ESG-Bench: Benchmarking Long-Context ESG Reports for Hallucination Mitigation
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating hallucination and factual grounding in Large Language Models when processing ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) reports. While ESG involves corporate ethics and social responsibility, the study focuses on the technical accuracy of information extraction and reasoning rather than benchmarking the model's religious, moral, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
